items.title: Important Context & Safety
items.text: Limited Evidence: Like other hangover supplements, clinical evidence supporting strong hangover-prevention effects is limited, and moderation remains the only reliable way to avoid a hangover. Regulatory History: In 2020, the FDA issued a warning letter to Purple Biosciences, LLC over past hangover prevention/cure marketing claims. Current product labeling frames the pills as general wellness and hydration/liver support rather than a medical treatment or cure. Precautions: Check with a doctor first if you take medications, are pregnant or breastfeeding, or have a medical condition.
